## Exact version / commit

Provide the exact goodLAC commit SHA or release candidate.

## Environment

Include relevant OS, Python/Node versions, sandbox/runtime details, and whether this is the default governed Pi path.

## Expected behavior

What should have happened?

## Observed behavior

What happened instead?

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest reproducible sequence that does not expose credentials or create unnecessary consequential effects.

## Authority / trust boundary

Does this involve capability registration, policy, approvals, identity, credentials, persistence, sandboxing, networking, dispatch, receipts, emergency pause, or another trust boundary?

## Additional context

Include logs or sanitized evidence if useful.
